supported_by_source: T4 meets vLLM general CUDA minimum SM7.5.
The exact README call on T4 uses auto dtype and source policy resolves Ovis BF16 configuration to FP16 fallback with warnings.
Requested Triton GDN route has no explicit SM8 gate in inspected dispatcher, and its entry dtype check allows FP16.
unknown_without_hosted_execution: Whether the pinned CUDA12.8 vLLM/Torch2.11 stack installs in the target Kaggle environment.
Whether all Ovis-specific Triton/FLA kernels compile and run on SM7.5.
Whether model initializes within target memory and produces expected outputs.
Whether vLLM Torch2.11 with Transformers5.16.1 reproduces metadata workflow using Torch2.14.0; no cross-stack parity has been tested.
unsupported_by_source: Explicit BF16 on T4 is rejected because it requires SM>=8.
T4 auto-FP16 is a different numerical reference from BF16 execution on SM>=8; it cannot establish BF16-equivalent decoded quality by assumption.

reference_policy: If T4 is used, label outputs as the README auto-FP16 T4 path; retain a separate BF16-capable SM>=8 reference gate for BF16 parity claims.
scope: Pinned public source and existing public metadata only; no installation, model/device execution, kernel compilation, or output parity test

sources.fact: Example constructs LLM with gdn_prefill_backend="triton" and no dtype argument.
Default dtype auto resolves a model config dtype against platform supported dtypes and falls back with warning; qwen3_5 is absent from the float16 exclusion list.
Missing root dtype falls back to nested text_config.dtype.
CUDA SM>=8 supports BF16; Turing supports FP16 and FP32; explicit BF16 check requires SM>=8.
Requested triton selects in-tree Triton/FLA prefill; FlashInfer selection needs SM90 or qualified SM100, and is not required by requested Triton path.
Chunk GDN entry check rejects float32 but does not reject float16.
Pinned vLLM source fixes torch==2.11.0 and flashinfer-python/cubin==0.6.11.post2.
Lists NVIDIA SM>=7.5 including T4; default wheel CUDA12.9, offers CUDA12.8 variant.
Separate metadata/export workflow pins CPU torch==2.14.0 and transformers==5.16.1; this does not prove compatibility with vLLM torch==2.11.0.

packaging_followup.scope: Source availability and actual hardware gate, not model inference qualification
packaging_followup.interpretation: Installed toolkit12.8 does not determine support for the isolated published CUDA12.9 wheel; actual driver meets the conservative gate. The generic documentation did not establish that this exact release publishes a cu128 wheel.
